label: Search Reader (Server RBAC role)
type: a Server RBAC role, one of the 56 in learn/security/roles.md. NOT a privilege: Server's concrete role catalogue has no separately enumerable privilege tier. Do NOT confuse with the privilege:capella-advanced-access-fts-* family, which is Capella's genuinely separate privilege catalogue and has its own distinct ids for Search access.
note: Re-filed from privilege: to role: in round 12, in the same sweep as the nine query_* ids. roles.md documents this as one of 56 Server RBAC roles, with its own 'Role: <label> (<internal_name>)' table and prose calling it a role outright. Recurrence 1 (fts-introduction.md), promoted under the same family exception as query-delete: the point is the alias, which turns future silent reuse of the privilege: form into a gate denial. Note the label/token mismatch - the role is called Search Reader but its internal name is fts_searcher, the same class of mismatch as Manage Sequences / query_use_sequences.
